# Desert: the sand floor around the court (a faceted grid just below the border, open under the court) and dunes behind
# and beside the temple. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sand --base-color 0.1569 0.1020 0.1765 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Sand --x-subdivisions 12 --y-subdivisions 9 --size 1 --location 0 0.6875 -0.03
scale 18 12.375 1
apply --scale
apply --location
mode edit
# no sand under the court: its grid lines meet at x +-4.5, y +-2.75, inside the court's border
select face where "abs(pos.x) < 4.5 && abs(pos.y) < 2.75"
delete only-faces
select vert where "abs(pos.x) > 5.9 || pos.y < -4.6 || pos.y > 6.9"
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 3
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name D0 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location -7.6 6.2 0
scale 2.40 1.60 0.50
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name D1 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 7.4 6.0 0
scale 2.70 1.80 0.70
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name D2 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location -8.8 3.6 0
scale 2.40 1.60 0.45
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name D3 --subdivisions 2 --radius 1 --location 8.8 3.4 0
scale 2.40 1.60 0.50
apply --scale
select Sand D0 D1 D2 D3
active Sand
join
material assign Sand
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.15 && (abs(pos.x) > 5.9 || pos.y > 5.5)"
delete vert
select vert where "abs(pos.x) > 5.9 || pos.y > 5.5"
randomize --amount 0.12 --seed 9
mode object
shade flat
export desert.glb
